content: Started in Java and .NET; spent 8+ years on the dell.com engineering and support team.
Continuously hands-on across systems, web, mobile, cloud, and AI—learning by building.

description: Lead a boutique AI consultancy, wearing multiple hats across developer experience, technical delivery, marketing, and hands-on implementation—operating with startup agility and minimal structure.
Architect and ship production AI systems including multi-tenant voice AI with RAG, autonomous agent platforms, and provider-agnostic LLM tooling.
Author ShrikeDB, a Redis-compatible in-memory database in Rust built on a shared-nothing multi-shard Tokio runtime.

experiences.position: Global Head of Community, DevRel, Developer Experience
description: Led global DevRel + DX function spanning developer education, evangelism, documentation, and multi-language SDK strategy.
Owned the roadmap for SDK + documentation improvements across 6 languages, prioritizing friction reduction and time-to-first-successful-call.
Grew the developer community through high-impact education, including a YouTube channel exceeding 155K subscribers and 13M views.
Led and coached a team of six Developer Educators/Evangelists.
Executive owner for developer evangelism strategy across major language ecosystems.
Led a global org (Developer Advocates + Community leadership) with a shared vision and roadmap for technical assets, field enablement, and community growth.
Delivered thought leadership and technical talks with reported reach of 8M+ engineers, architects, and technical leaders.
Led a global team driving developer engagement through education, strategic partnerships, and community outreach.
Represented JFrog at major events, creating demos and tutorials to help developers onboard and succeed with the platform.

experiences.position: Director - Head of Developer Relations & Community
description: Owned global Developer Evangelism + DX strategy for Docker's 15M+ developer ecosystem.
Produced and hosted the Docker Build show; led flagship events including DockerCon.
Revitalized and scaled the Docker Captains and Community Leaders advocacy programs.
Led re-architecture of four monolithic properties into a unified microservices architecture using CI/CD, AWS, and Docker Swarm.
Drove infrastructure-as-code adoption with Terraform across Docker's customer-facing properties.
Managed a 15-person team across 3 timezones owning docs.docker.com, success.docker.com, and support.docker.com.
Architected and shipped serverless backends on AWS Lambda and API Gateway, designing event-driven workflows and REST/JSON APIs.
Managed a combined $1.8M budget across projects including resource planning, hiring, and road-mapping.
Architected and coded full-stack solutions in JavaScript, React, Redux, Angular, Node.js, and MongoDB.
